title: Topology, Morphology, Silhouette, Appendage & Modular Anatomy Authoring
objective: Implement topology-aware component/parameter authoring for humanoid/biped, quadruped, serpentine, winged, multi-limbed, aquatic, composite, constructed/modular and extensible families, including proportion/silhouette controls and eligible tails, wings, fins, extra limbs, tentacles and modular parts with explicit compatibility/anchor validation.

scope.purpose: Provide renderer-neutral topology/morphology authoring over governed entity/body eligibility without becoming canonical anatomy, Form, mechanics, equipment, relationship or live-state authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative humanoid and nonhumanoid bodies can be author-projected with deterministic topology, morphology, silhouette, appendage and modular-part plans; incompatible anchors fail closed; unsupported/unresolved anatomy remains explicit; no canonical owner mutation occurs.

selection_boundaries: MCCS-01 completed the creator-workspace/renderer-neutral projection foundation and is not reopened.
The DAG-authorized MNCS rotation after MCCS-01 is now terminal through MNCS-24; the interrupted MCCS local order resumes at MCCS-03.
Character/NPC/Creature/Species/Form/PPIA owners retain canonical identity, topology eligibility, Form/state, mechanics and live entity truth.
CAPP/PPIA retain renderer-neutral appearance authority; PAPT/PCA retain reusable asset/rig/local-production primitives; ARI retains resource identity/provenance/rights.
MCCS-03 is topology-first rather than humanoid-first and preserves unsupported/unresolved anatomy instead of fabricating compatibility.
The independent ui-implementation UISR-10 and player-species MVPS-07 lanes remain independently active and unchanged.
